sn10.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || Atha kho Sakka-nāmako yakkho yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn10.2:2.1: Sabbaganthapahīnassa || vippamuttassa te sato || samaṇassa na taṃ sādhu || yad aññam anusāsatī ti || ||
sn10.2:3.1: Yena kenaci vaṇṇena || saṃvāso Sakka jāyati || na tam arahati sappañño || manasā anukampituṃ || ||
sn10.2:4.1: manasā ce pasannena || yad aññam anusāsati || na tena hoti saṃyutto || sānukampā anuddayā ti || ||
